description: Migration script for version 5.1.0 in OrangeHRM system, handling database schema updates, language strings, permissions, menu configurations, and workflow states related to HR functionalities like performance reviews, workflows, themes, and user roles.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database schema updates, permission assignments, language string management, menu configuration, and workflow state insertions for HRM system version 5.1.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs all migration steps including database updates, language strings, permissions, and workflow state insertions.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TranslationHelper.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: addValidColumnToRequestResetPassword
methods.description: Adds an 'expired' boolean column to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table.

methods.name: insertModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Inserts default page entries for a module, user role, and action.

methods.name: insertReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states related to review processes.

methods.name: insertSelfReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states for self-review processes.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Helper to insert a workflow state into the workflow state machine table.

methods.name: insertReviewListScreenForAdminRole
methods.description: Associates a review list screen with the admin role, setting permissions.

methods.name: modifyThemeTable
methods.description: Alters the theme table: dropping/adding columns, renaming, and updating theme variables.

methods.name: modifyTrackerLogsUserForeignKey
methods.description: Updates foreign key constraints on the performance tracker log to set proper on-delete behavior.

methods.name: modifyEmployeeTrackerScreenRolePermission
methods.description: Updates user role permissions for the employee performance tracker screen.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class for specific menu items.

methods.name: updateRecruitmentMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to recruitment functionalities.

methods.name: updatePerformanceMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to performance functionalities.
